summary.predict_mean_testfitted_caveat: predict_mean_testfitted_mse uses the mean of the test next-states themselves. This is the original evaluate_fusion.py definition and is reported only for comparison. It is a test-fitted baseline and must not be used as the primary metric.
summary.context_handling: causal K=8 window; left context clipped at episode start (k_effective=1..8 for the first 8 transitions of each episode, then 8). No padding, no cross-episode leakage.

scope: test episode identifiers excluded from new training loader; same source task, not new environments
limitations: encoded-state MSE, not raw-pixel reconstruction or planning/action-selection quality
world mixers remain SAO; SAVO flag affects LM core only
test-fitted mean secondary only; primary constant baseline uses train states
